title: Pre-career Support systems (Psychosocial, social, mentorship/coach ing, spiritual, career support system)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Support systems: psychosocial, social, mentorship and coaching, spiritual and career. Name local ones: the school counsellor, a church or mosque youth leader, a mentor, career days.

skills.key_step: The child names pre-career support systems and says why pre-career mapping matters.
steps: Link interests to careers on a map.
Say how the map can change.

board.do: Draw the learner in the middle of a web.

board.say: Who else can support a learner's career choice?

board.do: Wait for a counsellor, teacher, mentor or faith leader.

misconceptions.ask: Which is a pre-career support system?
misconceptions.repair: List trusted sources (counsellor, teacher, mentor, parent) and untrusted ones and sort them.
Show that a map links interests to several careers and can change as the learner grows.

misconceptions.ask: Who can advise a learner on careers?
misconceptions.repair: Make a support web with parents, teachers, counsellors, mentors and faith leaders.

misconceptions.ask: How can a faith leader support a learner choosing a career?
misconceptions.repair: Add faith leaders to the support web.

checks.question: Which is a pre-career support system: a rumour or a school counsellor?
What does pre-career mapping do?
checks.answer: links interests and abilities to careers

skills.key_step: The child analyses challenges in pre-career support systems and pairs each with a fitting solution.
representations: a role play with a parent
steps: Ask what it is missing: people, information, money or freedom.
Pick the solution that supplies it.
contexts: a rural school with no counsellor
a parent pressing for one career

board.do: Write: "no career information in a rural school".

board.say: What solution supplies the missing information?

board.do: Wait for career days or visits.

misconceptions.ask: Give one challenge a rural learner may face in getting career guidance.
misconceptions.repair: Compare a town school with a career office and a rural school without one.

listen_for: Do what the parent says without talking
misconceptions.ask: A parent wants a learner to be a doctor, but the learner loves art. What is a good step?
misconceptions.repair: Role-play a respectful talk with a parent.

misconceptions.ask: A post says one course guarantees a big salary. What should you do?
misconceptions.repair: Compare a post with the official course guide.

misconceptions.ask: Which solution fits "too few counsellors in a school"?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what the problem is missing: people to talk to.

misconceptions.ask: Besides money, give one challenge in pre-career support.
misconceptions.repair: List challenges in three columns: money, people, information.

checks.question: Give one challenge in pre-career support systems.
checks.answer: any of: too few counsellors, little information, parental pressure, cost, misinformation

checks.question: Which solution fits misinformation online?
checks.answer: checking with a counsellor or official sources
